usage: Use 淺紫色 to talk about a light purple colour. 例如：呢件衫係淺紫色。
It can describe clothes, objects, or design styles. 例如：我鍾意淺紫色嘅袋。
You can put it before a noun, just like other colour words. 例如：淺紫色花好靚。
It is a neutral, everyday word, and people use it in both speech and writing. 例如：牆身油咗淺紫色。
